h1: Why a Garage Door Goes Off Track

sections.body: Doors jump the track when a roller fails, a cable snaps, or the door is forced while an opener is fighting it. In Glendale the fix is usually a roller and cable reset plus realignment - not a whole new door.

faq.a: Call for same-day garage door service in Glendale, AZ.
